question: Which statement about the Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG) 2023 is accurate?

options.text: Conducted across four cities in Maharashtra
Included exactly 20 sports with no demo events

solution:
The correct answer is __**Held over 13 days at 15 venues**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Khelo India Youth Games (KIYG) 2023** was held across **13 days**, emphasizing its scale and significance in fostering sports culture in India.
 
• The event took place at **15 different venues** in Maharashtra, ensuring wide accessibility and promoting sports infrastructure development in the state.
 
• The **KIYG 2023** was a major initiative under the **Khelo India Programme**, which is aimed at reviving sports culture in India at the grassroots level.
 
• The competition featured over **4,000 young athletes** from various states, showcasing their skills across multiple sports disciplines.
 
• This initiative reinforces the Indian government’s commitment to identify and nurture talent for future international competitions, such as the Olympics.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About the Khelo India Programme:**

 
 
• The **Khelo India Programme** was launched by the Government of India in **2018** to promote sports and fitness among youth and to create a sporting ecosystem in the country.
 
• It includes initiatives such as the **Talent Identification and Development Scheme**, infrastructure development, and the organization of annual youth games.
 
• The programme has a focus on **sports for all** and **sports for excellence**.
 
 
 
• **KIYG 2023 Sports:**
 
 
• The event featured over **20 sports disciplines**, including both traditional and modern sports, such as wrestling, archery, athletics, football, and hockey.
 
• It also included **demonstration sports** to introduce emerging sports to the audience and participants.
 
 
 
• **Participation:**
 
 
• Over **4,000 athletes** participated, with representation from all states and union territories, fostering inclusivity in sports.
 
• The event encouraged the participation of young athletes under the age of **21 years**, providing them a platform to showcase their talent.
 
 
 
• **Significance of Maharashtra:**
 
 
• Maharashtra, the host state, has been a key player in promoting sports culture in India, with robust infrastructure and training facilities for athletes.
 
• The event was hosted in **four cities** in Maharashtra, including Pune, Nagpur, Mumbai, and Aurangabad, ensuring maximum outreach and participation.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Government Support:**

 
 
• The Government of India provides **financial and technical assistance** to states and union territories under the Khelo India initiative.
 
• The event is organized in collaboration with the **Sports Authority of India (SAI)**.
 
 
 
• **Future Prospects:**
 
 
• The KIYG serves as a platform for **talent scouting** for international competitions, such as the Asian Games and Olympics.
 
• It encourages **grassroots sports development** and helps in building a pipeline of future national and international sports stars.
